LESSON: VEGETATION IN EASTERN AFRICA

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.4: Vegetation in Eastern Africa

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Vegetation in Eastern Africa. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can we conserve vegetation in our environment?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the main types of vegetation in Eastern Africa on a map
2. draw a map of Eastern Africa and label the main types of vegetation
3. describe the characteristics of the main types of vegetation in Eastern Africa
4. explain ways of conserving vegetation in the environment
5. value vegetation found at home and school

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: VEGETATION IN EASTERN AFRICA
This lesson teaches Vegetation in Eastern Africa for Grade 6 SOCIAL STUDIES.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify the main types of vegetation in Eastern Africa on a map
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. draw a map of Eastern Africa and label the main types of vegetation
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. describe the characteristics of the main types of vegetation in Eastern Africa
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
4. explain ways of conserving vegetation in the environment
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
5. value vegetation found at home and school
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Vegetation in Eastern Africa using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Vegetation in Eastern Africa above.
2. Explain Vegetation in Eastern Africa to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Vegetation in Eastern Africa.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Vegetation in Eastern Africa with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Vegetation in Eastern Africa important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can we conserve vegetation in our environment?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the main types of vegetation in Eastern Africa on a map
2. draw a map of Eastern Africa and label the main types of vegetation
3. describe the characteristics of the main types of vegetation in Eastern Africa
4. explain ways of conserving vegetation in the environment
